data.gender_notes: Thurston is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Thurstan or Thurstanus is derived from the Old English words thor, meaning thunder, and stan, meaning stone. This name was given to strong, fierce protectors in ancient England. In the Anglo-Saxon culture, names often reflected a person's occupation or status, and Thurstan was a name for a warrior or a nobleman. The name Thurston carries the meaning “Strong, fierce protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Thurston usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, fierce protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Thurston total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

It was a name given to protectors and warriors, symbolizing their powerful connection with the elemental force of thunder. Thurstan men were esteemed for their bravery and leadership, often assuming positions of power and authority in their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Thurstan or Thurstanus can represent a deep connection to the divine. The thunder represent the awe-inspiring power of God, and the stone symbolizes steadfastness and unwavering faith. A bearer of this name can embody the resilient and unyielding spirit embodied by the Old English roots, while drawing inspiration from the spiritual implications of their name. Additionally, the name reminds us of the power and protection that can only come from a connection to the divine.
